verdicts.reason: Both break up the schedule list. TUE sits far left, WED sits under the headline, and THU is jammed to the right of the logo, so the day order and grouping are lost. The TUE and THU lines are also illegibly tiny. A keeps the WED row at the same small scale as the others and leaves a gap before 'All free, all at 19:00'. B enlarges only the WED row, which makes the three items inconsistent and creates a competing focal point. B also crams 'All free, all at 19:00.' right against 'Drawing by hand in 2026', so they read as one run-on line.
